{{Quote|He was brought up on charges, stripped of all rank, and sent into exile on an uninhabited world at the edge of Imperial space.|[[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] about [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="Vision">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
A '''planet''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], and was the place to which [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]].

==History==
Thrawn was rediscovered here when the [[Strikefast/Legends|''Strikefast'']] chased [[Booster Terrik]] into the Unknown Regions, forcing Terrik to land on the planet. Thrawn managed to manipulate the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] into getting aboard their ship as a way off the planet.

As Thrawn was looking for a way off the planet when the Imperials arrived, it is implied that this planet had no other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] inhabitants, although there were other [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], namely, small, flying critters.
